item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["041169a9ae7b06ae2762","6d8c1a69536eae6609bd"],"operation":"Construct an XPath query through pugi::xpath_query::xpath_query.","condition":"The query exceeds the XPath parser's depth limit.","capability":"Reach the parser's depth check and report its query-depth error through the public query operation.","consequence":"The over-limit query is not rejected with the query-depth error.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe depth-limit error handling for the same over-limit public query construction."},{"member_ids":["a9cecfb3a853ede7449d","1466c3001e6a8e53c56e","3e9b61ec730e437e8f5c","2998365a9c586ca23a8b","8cf2e8be222792bec09b"],"operation":"Compile an XPath variable reference through pugi::xpath_query::xpath_query.","condition":"The query references a defined variable such as $x or $name.","capability":"Supply a populated xpath_variable_set to the constructor so the parser can resolve the reference.","consequence":"The variable reference cannot compile because the parser lacks the supplied variable set.","equivalence_reason":"Each describes variable-reference compilation with a supplied variable set; differences in evidence and certainty do not change the hypothesized operation or failure."},{"member_ids":["db781a84f1ff61c8350b"],"operation":"Evaluate a constructed xpath_query against an XML node, such as through evaluate_boolean(const xpath_node&).","condition":"An XPath query has been constructed and an XML node is available for evaluation.","capability":"Invoke a query evaluation method with the XML node.","consequence":"The constructed query's evaluation behavior is not exercised.","equivalence_reason":"This concerns evaluation after construction, a distinct operation from depth validation and variable-reference compilation."}]}
